UI_EOC_Enabled_tooltip: Draws coloured bars under the item icon in the inventory: condition of weapons and tools, and remaining contents of consumables.
UI_EOC_Weapons: Show condition of weapons and tools
UI_EOC_Weapons_tooltip: Draws the condition bar on weapons and tools (green, yellow, orange, red). The weapon head bar has its own option.
UI_EOC_Clothing_tooltip: Also draws the condition bar on clothing (wear, holes and tears lower it).
UI_EOC_Soiled_tooltip: If the Defecation mod is active, soiled clothing shows a brown icon on the item. Washing the item removes the mark.
UI_EOC_Head_tooltip: On weapons with a head (axes, spears, hammers...), draws a second bar with the head condition.
UI_EOC_HideFull_tooltip: Do not draw the bar on items in perfect condition.
UI_EOC_Contents_tooltip: Draws a blue bar with what is left in lighters, matches, batteries, tape, thread, liquid containers and magazines. It turns red when almost empty.
UI_EOC_Stacks_tooltip: On a closed stack of several items, shows the bars of the item in the worst state.
UI_EOC_Fresh_tooltip: Draws a bar on perishable food with the time left before it rots: green while fresh, orange when stale, full red when rotten and light blue when frozen. Canned and non-perishable food shows no bar.
UI_EOC_Position_tooltip: Where the bars are drawn on the item icon: along the bottom, along the top, or vertical on the left or right side (vertical bars fill from bottom to top).
UI_EOC_Blood_tooltip: Shows a red drop on the item icon when it has blood: clothing, weapons and tools, and bags you wear. The more blood, the stronger the colour.
UI_EOC_Dirt_tooltip: Shows a mud stain on the item icon when clothing or a bag is dirty. The dirtier, the stronger the colour.
UI_EOC_Wet_tooltip: Shows a blue drop on the item icon when clothing is wet, or when an item such as a book or paper got wet.
UI_EOC_Tooltips: Show info on bars and icons
UI_EOC_Tooltips_tooltip: When the mouse is over a bar or a status icon, shows a small box with the state and its percentage (and the days left for food).
UI_EOC_Tip_SoiledHint: Wash it to remove the stain
UI_EOC_Containers_tooltip: Draws a bar on the buttons of the container column (your inventory, bags, furniture, car trunks...) with how full each one is: green with room, yellow and orange as it fills, red when full. The floor has no bar.
